messages:
Maya: Starting region-by-region rollout now: US -> EU -> APAC. Pinning model v2.3.1 for this rollout. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Please perform capacity checks for your region. @Alex @SRE-Liz
Deploy-bot: kickoff accepted. Canary in us-west-2 (10%) starting. Command: `deploy --env prod --region us --pct 10 --image v2.3.1`
Alex: us check: warm pool at 85%, GPU queue length steady, we have ~1200 qps headroom. Will watch for 10 mins. :thumbsup:
Jonathan: eu check: canary scheduled on eu-west-1, but thermal headroom low on rack-3. Recommending hold at 5% until we verify cooling. tagging @Anna-ops
Anna-ops: on it, spinning extra warm nodes in eu-west-1 (2x c6gn) and increasing throttles. ETA 6m.
Deploy-bot: us canary reached 10% — aggregating perf: p95=190ms, errors 0.02% (baseline 0.01%). KV cache hit rate 72%. No rollback triggered.
SRE-Liz: noted p95 bump. Is that per-request or per-token? Also confirm quantized fallback not in use.
Alex: per-request (tail latency). Looks like longer seqs in one customer workload. I've flagged their route and applied a path pin to v2.2.9 for that route: `route.pin --route /chat/longseq --version v2.2.9`
Maya: OK. Hold EU canary until Anna confirms warm nodes. If EU stabilizes, proceed with EU -> APAC. Rollback criteria: sustained p95 > 300ms for 5m or error rate >0.5%.
Anna-ops: warm nodes online. re-run smoke: p95=170ms, errors 0%. cache hit 75%.
Jonathan: eu canary at 5% now. watchlist created. tagging @Alex for cross-region traffic shaping.
Deploy-bot: eu canary steady. metrics: p95=175ms, errors 0.01%. proceeding to eu 25% in 10m if stable.
Maya: Note: APAC change window shorter (02:00-03:30 UTC for APAC region). Ping on any warmup regressions. @SRE-Liz set thermal guard.
SRE-Liz: Thermal guard set: if GPU temp > 82C for 3m, auto-throttle 20% and alert #eng-oncall.
Deploy-bot: EU moved to 25% — no anomalies. Starting US ramp to 50% now.
Alex: US 50% p95=195ms errors 0.03%. Keeping an eye.
Maya: Consensus: proceed to APAC canary after EU full 100%? We planned US->EU->APAC with safe state checks. Propose EU to 100% then APAC 5%.
Anna-ops: Agree. EU to 100% in 5m, will continue monitoring.
Deploy-bot: EU at 100%. All health checks green. Kicking APAC canary 5% (ap-southeast-1).
Jonathan: APAC thermal corridor ok, but note bandwidth to our private region is constrained; expect slower cold starts. Suggest initial burst cap 8 QPS for canary.
Maya: Set burst cap to 8 QPS for APAC canary, also enable prefix cache priming for top routes.
Deploy-bot: APAC canary started. metrics after 3m: p95=240ms, errors 0.05%, cold-starts 12%. Monitoring. :eyes: 
SRE-Liz: p95 higher than EU/US but within rollback threshold. If p95 crosses 300ms for 5m, rollback. If errors spike >0.5% will auto-rollback.
Alex: I'm going to throttle non-critical background jobs in APAC to free GPU cycles.
Maya: Thanks. Keep updates short. If we hit rollback triggers, we fall back to v2.2.9 globally for 15m then re-evaluate.
Deploy-bot: APAC canary stable at 5% for 15m. p95 averaged 230ms, errors 0.03%. Preparing 25% in 10m.
Jonathan: Noted. Preparing release notes entry: 'v2.3.1: performance improvements, changed KV cache heuristics, minor API compatibility fixes. APAC cold-starts expected on first rollouts—see ops section.'
Maya: I'll send a brief changelog to #product and update the console release notes. Great work team. :party_parrot:
